//: Layer 1 (lowest precedence). C0 = LibreLane's out-of-the-box Classic flow, made explicit.
FP_CORE_UTIL 50 is LibreLane's default. PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT 60 equals LibreLane's automatic value
(FP_CORE_UTIL + 5*GPL_CELL_PADDING + 10 with padding 0 on all three PDKs); it is written explicitly so the
density knob is independent of the utilisation knob. Interface/SDC values come from each PDK (platforms.json).
Clock period: per design x PDK in configs/designs/<design>/pdks/<pdk>.json, measured by scripts/calibrate_clock.py.
